s.t:
S&L Connect ist ein auf Agrartechnik sowie Rasen- und Grundstückspflege spezialisiertes Unternehmen und offizieller Partner von John Deere. Als verlässlicher Ansprechpartner stehen wir für landwirtschaftliche Produktivität sowie hochwertige Maschinen und Dienstleistungen.

Mit einem engagierten Team an zehn Standorten in Südbrandenburg und Sachsen bieten wir fortschrittliche Lösungen, die gezielt auf die vielfältigen Anforderungen von Landwirten und Grundstückseigentümern ausgerichtet sind. Unsere Mitarbeitenden, Kunden und Partner bilden dabei die Grundlage unseres nachhaltigen Erfolgs.
Aufgaben
In deiner Rolle als Recruiter (m/w/d) bist du für die Gewinnung neuer Mitarbeitender und Auszubildender an unseren Standorten in Brandenburg und Sachsen verantwortlich. Du begleitest den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess von der Bedarfsplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Einstellung und stehst unseren Führungskräften als kompetenter Ansprechpartner zur Seite.

Darüber hinaus betreust du unsere Auszubildenden während ihrer gesamten Ausbildungszeit und repräsentierst unser Unternehmen auf Messen und Recruiting-Veranstaltungen.
Die Position kann an unseren Standorten Großenhain oder Ostrau ausgeübt werden. Regelmäßige Dienstreisen zu unseren Standorten in Brandenburg und Sachsen gehören zu deinem Aufgabenbereich.

Beratung der Führungskräfte bei der Personalbedarfsplanung sowie Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Stellenbeschreibungen und Anforderungsprofilen
Steuerung des gesamten Recruiting-Prozesses von der Stellenausschreibung über die Bewerberauswahl bis zur Zu- oder Absage

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Ausbildern und Führungskräften sowie Ansprechpartner*in für die Auszubildenden während ihrer gesamten Ausbildungszeit (die fachliche Ausbildung erfolgt durch die jeweiligen Ausbilder*in)
Organisation und Teilnahme an Ausbildungs-, Karriere- und Recruitingmessen sowie weiteren Maßnahmen des Ausbildungsmarketings

Jobbeschreibung
Recruiter (m/w/d)
Du bist ehrgeizig, smart und willst nicht jahrelang warten, bis man dir Verantwortung gibt? Dann lies weiter.
Bei den großen Personaldienstleistern lernst du erst monatelang Recruiting, bevor du überhaupt an den Vertrieb darfst. Bei uns nicht. Als Recruiter (m/w/d) übernimmst du von Anfang an den kompletten Zyklus: Du gewinnst Kunden, berätst sie strategisch – und setzt die Recruiting-Projekte anschließend selbst um. Eine Rolle, doppelte Kompetenz, volle Verantwortung für deinen Erfolg.
Wir sind eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in Bielefeld und helfen Unternehmen, ihre Arbeitgebermarke zu stärken und planbar qualifizierte Talente zu gewinnen – mit datenbasiertem Recruiting und strukturiertem Vertrieb. Und wir arbeiten in einem Markt, der durch Fachkräftemangel und demografischen Wandel jedes Jahr weiter wächst.

s.h: Profitiere als Recruiter (m/w/d) von unseren Benefits
s.t:
Attraktives Fixgehalt + ungedeckelte Bonuszahlungen : Deine Leistung entscheidet, was am Monatsende auf deinem Konto landet – nach oben offen.
Unbefristete Festanstellung : Wir bauen langfristig auf dich – Zukunftssicherheit in einer Branche, die durch die Digitalisierung und den Fachkräftemangel stetig wächst.
Echte 360°-Entwicklung : Du baust dir Kompetenz in Vertrieb UND Recruiting auf – das Profil, das im Markt am gefragtesten ist. Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter → Junior Consultant → Senior Consultant.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & Coaching : Umfassende Einarbeitung, professionelle Schulungen in Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb sowie regelmäßige Feedback-Sessions
Premium - Arbeitsplatz : Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman Miller-Stühle, Apple-Technik (MacBook Air/Pro, iMac) – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Gesundheit im Fokus : Premium-Fitnessvertrag bei einem Studio deiner Wahl.
Top - Versorgung im Office : Faema E61-Siebträgermaschine mit Julius Meinl-Kaffee, hochwertige Tees und flexibles Lunch-System von Meyer Menü
Teamkultur auf Augenhöhe : Kollegiale, leistungsorientierte Atmosphäre mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung – deine Ideen werden gehört und umgesetzt.

Du kontaktierst aktiv potenzielle Neukunden per Telefon und Direktansprache und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Du analysierst die Recruiting-Herausforderungen der Unternehmen, identifizierst konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Strategien.
Du präsentierst deine Lösungen überzeugend und begleitest den Prozess bis zum Abschluss.

Nach Vertragsabschluss steuerst du das Projekt eigenständig weiter – von der Kampagnenplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.
Du koordinierst eingehende Bewerbungen, qualifizierst Kandidaten vor und sorgst für eine professionelle Candidate Experience.

Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM, behältst deine Pipeline im Blick und arbeitest zielorientiert auf deine KPIs hin.
Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung zusammen und bringst Ideen zur Optimierung unserer Prozesse ein.
Das bringst du idealerweise mit
Vertriebsaffinität: Du hast Freude an Akquise und willst aktiv neue Kunden gewinnen – am Telefon, per Video-Call oder persönlich.
Beratungsverständnis: Du erkennst Potenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und präsentierst Lösungen strukturiert.
Menschenkenntnis: Du verstehst sowohl die Unternehmens- als auch die Bewerberperspektive.
Eigeninitiative & Leistungswille : Du arbeitest selbstständig, bleibst auch nach einem "Nein" am Ball und willst überdurchschnittliche Ergebnisse erzielen.
Wichtig : Ob Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg mit Vertriebserfahrung – uns interessiert nicht dein Lebenslauf, sondern dein Hunger. Recruiting-Vorerfahrung ist ein Plus, kein Muss – das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.
So geht's weiter
1. Bewerben in 2 Minuten – ohne Anschreiben, Lebenslauf genügt.
2. Kurzes Kennenlern-Telefonat – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.
3. Persönliches Gespräch in unserem Office in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Nimm deinen Erfolg JETZT selbst in die Hand – wir freuen uns auf dich!

Talent Acquisition Partner – Field Sales
🕐 Fixed-term (1-year) contract · Full-time
About SumUp
We believe in the everyday hero — those who have the courage to follow their passion and the determination to realise their dreams.
Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating powerful, easy-to-use financial solutions to help them run their businesses. With a founder's mentality and a team-first attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America, and the United States work together to ensure that small business owners can be successful doing what they love.

You'll join our Global Talent Acquisition team, dedicated to finding and empowering the best talent across SumUp. This role will focus on the Sales hiring stream, one of the fastest-growing and most business-critical areas at SumUp.
As a Senior TA professional, you'll work day-to-day with Sales leaders across Europe and help strengthen how we hire through process, data, stakeholder coaching, and disciplined execution. Depending on your experience and team needs, you will take part in leading initiatives and mentoring other TA team members.
You'll be based in one of our main hubs, Berlin and collaborate closely with colleagues across multiple European markets.

Own the end-to-end recruitment process for Field Sales roles across primarily Germany and other European markets.
Partner with Sales leaders to define scorecards, interview loops, and SLAs, ensuring Act as a trusted advisor to Sales leaders: clarify priorities, sense-check asks, and drive alignment on what "good" looks like.
Build and run structured hiring: scorecards, calibrated interview loops, interviewer guidance, and consistent decision-making.
Create persona-based sourcing and attraction plans, partnering with Employer Branding when needed.
Run weekly funnel and pipeline reviews, turning data into decisions
Identify systemic bottlenecks and drive improvements that raise hiring quality, speed, and candidate experience.
Bring strong offer and closing partnership: manage trade-offs, expectations, and decision-making to land hires effectively.
Maintain process discipline and ensure hiring practices remain compliant, fair, and consistent across markets.
You'll Be Great for This Role If You
Have strong experience owning Sales hiring in a fast-paced environment; you can manage complexity across multiple markets.
Are excellent at influencing senior stakeholders; you can challenge unrealistic or low-value requests constructively, without becoming a blocker.
Have a track record with structured hiring (scorecards, evidence-based assessment, calibrated decision-making).
Use data naturally to run your desk: you're fluent in funnel metrics, trade-offs, forecasting.
Combine hands-on execution with a system mindset: you improve the machine while running the process.
Communicate with clarity and pace, and you create trust through follow-through and high standards.
Fluency in English and German is a must, an additional European language is a plus (e.g. French, Italian, Portuguese or Spanish).
Why You Should Join SumUp
🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses around the world with simple, affordable tools to help them start, run, and grow. More than 4 million merchants across 36 markets trust us as their financial partner — and we're just getting started.
We're a global team of 3,000+ people from over 90 nationalities, united by curiosity, collaboration, and care. Our core values and culture shape everything we do, fostering inclusion, learning, and belonging.
SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, committed to building a safe, respectful, and diverse workplace where everyone can thrive.
👉 Explore more about our culture on our careers site , or follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

You don't need a perfect CV. You need the right skills.
This is not a role that filters by job title or tenure. It filters by what you can actually do.
We are looking for a recruiter who owns the full process — from the first Boolean search string to the signed offer, without
hand-holding, without process gaps, and without needing someone to define the search for them.
Skills are the filter, not biography. If you can demonstrate the capabilities below, we want to hear from you, regardless of how
your career path looks on paper.

You will be the driving force behind talent acquisition at a fast-growing, AI-powered HR Tech startup based in Berlin. This is an
internal recruiting role, not a staffing agency seat, not a volume-first environment.
You will own the complete hiring funnel: sharpen the role before searching, build and execute sourcing strategies, conduct
structured interviews, and manage stakeholders who need to be challenged, not just served.
Roles are thought of in terms of skill requirements, not job titles. The result is precision instead of volume. That's the standard
you'll work within and the standard you'll be held to.

A coordinator position waiting for candidates to come in
A reactive sourcing seat with no strategic mandate
A bureaucratic HR function with fixed playbooks and no autonomy

Full ownership of the recruiting process from identification to signed offer
A strategic partner seat, you challenge requirements, you advise, you deliver
A skill-first environment where your process quality matters more than your job title history
Your Skill Map
Core Skills are the central, non-negotiable capabilities of the role. Extended Skills are desirable additional competencies that
strengthen the profile but are not a knockout criterion.
Core Skills - KO Level
These are non-negotiable. If you cannot demonstrate these, this role is not a match.
Full-Cycle Recruiting Ownership
You independently drive the complete hiring process, from role clarification and sourcing strategy through structured
assessment to offer and close — without process gaps or handoffs mid-funnel.
What we look for: You can describe a search you ran end-to-end, including how you aligned the hiring manager on
requirements before searching, how you structured the funnel, and how you navigated blockers.
Active Sourcing via LinkedIn Recruiter
You can build and execute complex Boolean search strings from scratch, not just apply standard filters. You understand
how to construct multi-layer queries, use operators, and adapt strings to market signals.
What we look for: You can write a Boolean string for a target role live, explain the logic behind it, and describe how you would
adapt it if initial results are too narrow or too broad.
Competency-Based Interviewing
You conduct structured interviews using a defined competency framework. Your candidate assessments are evidencebased, documented, and defensible, not impressionistic.
What we look for: You can explain how you assess a specific competency in an interview, what question structure you use, and
how you document the evidence. You distinguish between self-reported claims and demonstrated behavior.
Stakeholder Advisory
You challenge hiring managers when role definitions are unrealistic, market expectations are off, or process decisions
create risk. You align before searching, not after.
What we look for: You can describe a situation where you pushed back on a hiring manager's position and explain how you
built the case and navigated the outcome.
Data-Driven Recruiting
You read, interpret, and act on funnel KPIs, time-to-hire, source-to-screen conversion, offer acceptance rates. You use
data to make process decisions, not just report them.
What we look for: You can describe a recruiting funnel metric you tracked, how you interpreted it, and what process change it
drove.
Language Skills — Non-Negotiable
German at C2 / native-equivalent level, required for candidate conversations, stakeholder communication, and process
documentation in a German-speaking context. English at C1+ level, required for written and verbal communication in an
international team environment.
AGG note: Both language requirements are professionally justified by the candidate-facing and client-facing nature of the role
Strong Skills - Valued, Not KO
These strengthen your application but will not exclude you if absent.
Talent Pool Architecture: You systematically build, segment, and maintain candidate pipelines for recurring roles, not ad hoc lists
AI & Tech Tool Affinity: You have hands-on experience with modern ATS systems and AI-assisted sourcing or matching tools
Employer Branding Contribution: You can co-create job ad copy, LinkedIn content, or employer brand messaging, not just distribute it
Startup / Scale-Up Navigation: You have delivered results in environments where process, structure, and resources were all still being built
What You'll Work With
AI-powered recruiting infrastructure: The team you'll join builds and operates its own recruiting tooling. You will use it daily.
Modern ATS environment: Structured pipelines, documented stages, KPI tracking built in
LinkedIn Recruiter: Including Recruiter Lite or full seat, depending on search volume
Direct collaboration with a small, senior team, no layers, short decision paths
A technology-first environment where manual workarounds are the exception, not the norm
The operating model follows a clear sequence: first understand, then structure, then automate. Everyone working here works not in individual cases, but within a system.
What's On Offer
Hybrid working model: Berlin base, flexible execution
Real ownership: You design and run your own processes within a clear framework, no micromanagement
Direct access to decision-makers: No approval chains for sourcing decisions or outreach copy
Growth context: You are part of building the internal recruiting capability, not maintaining a legacy setup
Purpose-driven work: Recruiting done properly: structured, skill-based, documented, and fair
Compensation: Salary is discussed transparently during the process, benchmarked against market data. No blanket figures
without basis. If this is relevant for you upfront, mention it in your application, we'll address it directly.
Our Hiring Process
We screen based on skills, not credentials. Here is what to expect:
Application review: A person reads every application, no automated filtering
Short intro call (20–30 min): Context, fit, mutual questions
Skills-based interview (60 min): Structured, competency-specific, with documented assessment
Optional: work sample or personality test: Role-relevant, time-boxed, focused on a real scenario
Final conversation + decision: Transparent feedback regardless of outcome
We aim to respond within 5 business days. If timelines shift, we communicate proactively.

Jobbeschreibung
Personalberater – Recruiting & Kundenbetreuung (m/w/d)
Du willst Unternehmen wirklich beraten statt nur Profile weiterzureichen – und dabei sehen, was dein Einsatz am Monatsende wert ist? Dann passt das hier.
Beratung und Umsetzung laufen in unserer Branche meist getrennt: Die einen verkaufen, die anderen besetzen, und keiner trägt das Ergebnis ganz. Wir machen es anders. In dieser Position begleitest du deine Kunden von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zur besetzten Stelle. Du weißt genau, was du versprochen hast – weil du es anschließend selbst einlöst.
Hinter dem Ganzen steht Aramaz Digital, eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mit Sitz in der Bielefelder Innenstadt. Wir machen Unternehmen als Arbeitgeber sichtbar und liefern ihnen kalkulierbar passende Bewerbungen – auf Basis von Daten, nicht von Bauchgefühl. Fachkräftemangel und demografischer Wandel sorgen dafür, dass unser Markt Jahr für Jahr größer wird.
Dein Aufgabengebiet
Kundenbetreuung und Neugeschäft
Du sprichst Unternehmen aktiv an – am Telefon und über Direktkontakte – und weckst Interesse an unseren digitalen Recruiting-Lösungen.
Im Gespräch findest du heraus, woran die Personalgewinnung tatsächlich hakt, und leitest daraus einen konkreten Vorschlag ab.
Du stellst dein Konzept überzeugend vor, verhandelst und bringst den Auftrag zum Abschluss.
Nach dem Start bleibst du fester Ansprechpartner deiner Kunden und baust die Zusammenarbeit weiter aus.
Recruiting und Projektsteuerung
Du planst die Kampagne, steuerst ihre Laufzeit und passt sie an, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen.
Du sichtest Bewerbungen, führst erste Gespräche zur Vorauswahl und sorgst dafür, dass Kandidaten den Prozess positiv erleben.
Bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung behältst du das Projekt in der Hand.
Organisation im Hintergrund
Du hältst deine Aktivitäten im CRM nach, kennst den Stand deiner Pipeline und arbeitest auf klar messbare Ziele hin.
Mit Marketing und Geschäftsführung stimmst du dich eng ab und bringst Ideen ein, wie wir unsere Abläufe schärfen können.
Das erwarten wir von dir
Freude an Akquise: Die aktive Kundenansprache ist für dich kein notwendiges Übel, sondern der Teil, der dich reizt.
Beraterisches Denken: Du stellst die Fragen, die den Kern treffen, erkennst Zusammenhänge und erklärst deine Lösung nachvollziehbar.
Blick für beide Seiten: Du verstehst, was Personalverantwortliche umtreibt – und was Bewerber überzeugt.
Eigener Antrieb: Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, steckst Absagen weg und willst mehr erreichen als das Nötigste.
Dein Werdegang ist zweitrangig: Studium, Ausbildung oder Quereinstieg aus dem Verkauf – entscheidend ist, was du willst, nicht was auf dem Papier steht. Erfahrung im Recruiting nehmen wir gerne mit, voraussetzen tun wir sie nicht.
Das bekommst du dafür
Vergütung nach oben offen: Festgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision ohne Deckelung.
Unbefristet ab dem ersten Tag: Wir planen langfristig mit dir, in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.
Zwei Kompetenzfelder gleichzeitig: Beratung und Personalgewinnung – eine Kombination, die dir jede Tür offen hält. Der Entwicklungsweg ist klar: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant.
Begleitete Einarbeitung: Strukturiertes Onboarding, Trainings zu Akquise, Beratung und Besetzung, dazu regelmäßige Feedbackrunden.
Arbeitsplatz auf hohem Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – zentral gelegen in Bielefeld.
Fitness auf uns: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.
Gut versorgt im Büro: Siebträgermaschine mit Julius-Meinl-Kaffee, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.
Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und trotzdem kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
Der Bewerbungsweg
Ohne Anschreiben bewerben – der Lebenslauf genügt, zwei Minuten reichen.
Telefonat zum Kennenlernen – Rückmeldung von uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden.
Gespräch vor Ort in unserem Büro in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.
Wenn du deinen nächsten Schritt selbst bestimmen willst: Wir freuen uns auf dich.

This is a fixed-term contract role supporting Prosci 's Talent Acquisition function across the US and Canada. The Sr. Contract Recruiter owns full life cycle recruiting for an assigned slate of open requisitions, from intake through offer, partnering closely with hiring managers and HR Business Partners to build strong candidate pipelines and a consistently positive candidate experience.
This role is intended to add recruiting capacity for a period of approximately 6 months (September 2026 – February 2027) with an anticipated workload of 20–40 hours per week; volume will vary with interview activity and open requisition load.
Since our founding in 1994, Prosci has been laser-focused on change. By combining our deep understanding of people with a proven methodology rooted in the creation of the ADKAR® model, we’ve helped countless people and organizations thrive. Our solutions empower customers with lasting change resiliency through a unique blend of training, advisory services, and licensing options, including Kaiya, our AI change management coach.
At Prosci , we are a purpose-driven organization full of passionate, curious, and results-oriented people. Working at Prosci means being part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to our purpose of creating a world where change is done right. Join us and be part of a culture that thrives on continuous learning, growth, and making a difference.
Check out our website for more about our team and approach: .

Recruiting
Manage full life cycle recruiting for assigned US and Canadian requisitions: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, assessment administration, reference and background checks, and offer support.
Lead intake and needs analysis conversations with hiring managers to confirm role scope, must-have criteria, and hiring timeline before opening a requisition.
Partner with HRBPs to create and publish job descriptions and postings.
Source active and passive candidates using Prosci 's ATS (Workable), LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, employee referrals, and other channels.
Conduct phone screens, coordinate interview loops, administer assessments, and lead scorecard completion and debrief discussions with interview teams.
Maintain regular, high-quality communication with candidates throughout the process to protect the candidate’s experience.
Support offer construction and, in partnership with the hiring HRBP and hiring manager, help negotiate terms with candidates.
Pipeline, Compliance, and Candidate Experience
Build and maintain candidate pipelines for roles that recur or are historically difficult to fill.
Apply sourcing, screening, and interview practices consistent with Prosci 's commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, including attention to underexplored talent pools.
Apply working knowledge of US and Canadian hiring requirements relevant to recruiting (for example, pay transparency rules, background check requirements, and state or provincial variation) and flag questions to HR Business Partners rather than making independent compliance calls.
Perform select preboarding activities for new hires from the point of offer acceptance to start date, including internal stakeholder communication, coordination of first day logistics, and scheduling of week 1 core onboarding sessions.
Reporting and Process
Keep candidate and requisition records current and accurate in the ATS (Workable).
Provide regular pipeline and hiring status updates to hiring managers and HR Business Partners.
Flag process friction or candidate experience issues to HR Business Partners and suggest improvements.

Full life cycle recruiting experience across sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer support, ideally spanning both US and Canadian hiring. Working knowledge of US and Canadian employment and hiring practices, with good judgment about when to escalate a compliance question (only US is required).
Working proficiency with an applicant tracking system and with LinkedIn Recruiter or an equivalent sourcing tool.
Strong written and verbal communication, comfortable managing multiple candidates, requisitions, and hiring manager relationships at once.
Ability to work independently against a defined requisition load with minimal day-to-day oversight.
Comfort using AI tools across the recruiting life cycle, primarily to synthesize interview notes and scorecard feedback into clear, evidence-based debrief summaries and candidate recommendations, with sound judgment about reviewing AI output for accuracy and bias before it informs a hiring decision.

5+ years of in-house or agency recruiting experience.
Demonstrated experience recruiting across a range of levels, from individual contributor through professional or exempt roles.
Experience recruiting for professional services, consulting, or other high-growth organization is a plus.
Prior contract or interim recruiting experience, comfortable ramping quickly on a new team's process and requisitions.
Experience with Predictive Index or a similar behavioral assessment tool.
Familiarity with competency-based, inclusive interviewing practices.
Additional Information
Work Location: Remote within the US or Canada.

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.
Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery.

The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.
At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.
Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Metrea Management  is our global shared service providing support for the Capabilities in areas such as People, Finance, Legal, Strategy, Safety, Security and Information Technology.
Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas—including airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special mission aviation, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation.

Whenever we operate, we build vertically integrated full stacks of capability—designing, building, and operating turnkey solutions that let customers scale capacity while benefiting from continuous cycles of innovation. With operators and engineers under one roof, we close the gap between lab and field—what we call connecting design with effect.

Metrea’s solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving. This approach enables our partners to do more with less and achieve outsized, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Metrea has facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and beyond.

At Metrea, we seek out the most demanding national security challenges and proactively develop elegant solutions – those solutions start with our people, and their ability to deliver mission-critical effects around the world.
Our Talent Acquisition team operates as a strategic function embedded in the business—bringing deep recruiting expertise, sharp market judgment, and a consultative approach that influences how the organization grows.

Find Exceptional Healthcare Leaders

Success in this role isn’t simply measured by activity. It’s about finding the right people—and engaging them effectively.

Mission
As we prepare to scale and launch in the US, you will bring immediate senior hiring capacity into Odin to close the priority leadership and high-impact roles for Q3 and Q4.

Drive the end-to-end hiring process for priority leadership and L3+ (Senior) roles, ensuring momentum, clarity, and consistent progress from kick-off to offer

Ensure all processes begin with a grounded understanding of what “great” looks like

You’re a thoughtful, experienced talent partner who cares deeply about people, process and outcomes, with strong internal filters and high standards
You’ve led multiple hiring processes at once, ideally in a fast-paced, early-stage environment where ambiguity, urgency and competing priorities are the norm
You have experience in talent operations and attention to detail – spotting blockers early, keeping things moving, and improving systems as you go
You’re a clear, intentional communicator across async, written and verbal channels – able to bring others with you and influence at a senior level
You lead confidently in ambiguity, surfacing risks, asking the right questions, and helping hiring managers move forward with aligned, quality decisions

You’ve got excellent hiring judgement across different functions – able to assess skills, behaviours and values alignment, not just experience on paper
You’re a strong sourcer who knows how to write compelling outreach and build genuine relationships with passive candidates

You’re curious and improvement-minded - always looking for ways to make the process better, and not afraid to challenge existing norms

Struggle to challenge or influence senior stakeholders – A strong candidate should be able to push back constructively, challenge thinking when needed, and drive clarity – even in rooms with senior leaders.

Play back opinions rather than surfacing original thinking – We need someone who brings their own views to the table, not just someone who agrees or repeats what’s already been said.
Over-focuses on the what rather than the how – Someone who takes things at face value, struggles to read between the lines, or doesn’t think critically about context won’t thrive. Bottom line
This isn’t about whether you’ve done 360 hiring before - it’s about how you approach it.

## Firmenbeschreibung ##
Seit nahezu 40 Jahren sind wir erfolgreich als Stellenvermittler unterwegs. Als Familien Unternehmen verbinden wir bewährte Werte mit modernen Arbeitsweisen, innovativen Lösungen und einem starken Teamgeist. Wir sind regional verwurzelt und schweizweit vernetzt.

Mit 28 Filialen in der Schweiz und in Liechtenstein sind wir nah bei unseren Kunden und gleichzeitig Teil eines starken nationalen Netzwerks. Was uns auszeichnet? Deshalb bieten wir die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, sich weiterzuentwickeln und aktiv zum Erfolg des Unternehmens beizutragen. About Mosaic Health
Mosaic Health is dedicated to transforming healthcare through innovative, patient-centered care models that improve outcomes and access. We are building a high-performing team of mission-driven professionals who are passionate about making healthcare better for patients, providers, and communities.

Mosaic Health is seeking an experienced and relationship-driven Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. Reporting to the Manager, Talent Acquisition, this role will be responsible for managing full-cycle recruiting across a variety of business functions, partnering closely with hiring managers to identify, attract, and hire top talent.
The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, data-driven, and passionate about delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience. This individual will play a critical role in supporting Mosaic Health's continued growth by developing effective sourcing strategies, managing candidate pipelines, and serving as a trusted talent advisor throughout the hiring process.

Full-Cycle Recruitment
Manage the end-to-end recruitment process from intake through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.
Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, role requirements, and ideal candidate profiles.
Develop and execute recruiting strategies to attract qualified and diverse talent.
Conduct candidate sourcing through job boards, professional networks, referrals, social media, and direct outreach.
Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate interviews to assess qualifications, experience, and cultural alignment.
Coordinate and facilitate interview processes, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and interview teams.
Manage offer development and negotiation in partnership with hiring managers and Human Resources.

Talent Partnership & Consultation
Serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers on recruiting best practices, market trends, and talent availability.
Provide guidance on interview techniques, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.
Build strong relationships with business leaders and stakeholders across the organization.
Ensure consistency and compliance throughout the hiring process.
Candidate Experience
Deliver a high-quality, professional, and engaging experience for all candidates.
Maintain timely communication with candidates throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Promote Mosaic Health's employer brand and value proposition in all candidate interactions.
Talent Pipeline Development
Build and maintain proactive talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Leverage market research and sourcing tools to identify top talent.
Develop and maintain relationships with passive candidates and industry professionals.
Recruiting Operations & Reporting
Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting activity within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Track and report on recruiting metrics, including time-to-fill, pipeline health, and source effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.
Support continuous improvement initiatives within the Talent Acquisition function.

Required
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in healthcare, corporate, technology, or high-growth environments.
Proven experience sourcing and recruiting for a variety of professional-level roles.
Strong interviewing, candidate assessment, and relationship-building skills.
Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter.
Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.
Ability to manage multiple requisitions and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

Experience recruiting within healthcare, value-based care, health technology, or related industries.
Experience supporting remote and geographically dispersed teams.
Knowledge of employment law and recruiting compliance requirements.
Experience utilizing recruiting analytics and workforce planning data to inform hiring strategies.
Competencies
Consultative and collaborative approach
Strong business acumen
Relationship building and stakeholder management
Results orientation and accountability
Adaptability and problem-solving
Attention to detail and operational excellence
Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

A passion for connecting talented individuals with meaningful career opportunities.
The ability to influence and build trust with hiring managers and candidates alike.
A proactive mindset and continuous improvement mentality.
A commitment to supporting Mosaic Health's mission, values, and culture.

At Mosaic Health, you'll have the opportunity to help build teams that directly impact the future of healthcare. You'll work alongside collaborative colleagues in a mission-driven environment that values innovation, inclusion, and professional growth while enjoying the flexibility of a fully remote work setting.
Mosaic Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

Somewhere out there is a sourcer who is better than their job title says they are. They hit their numbers at a company that never let them talk to a hiring manager. They found the candidate nobody else found and watched a recruiter take the credit. They have been told to be patient, to wait for the next cycle, to earn it.
We are not going to make you wait.
What we do
We build autonomous aircraft and Legion, the software that flies hundreds of them as one coordinated swarm. Series A, backed by Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. We are hiring software engineers and aircraft engineers at the same time, which is hard, and how fast we hire is one of the few things standing between the current aircraft and the next one.
That is not a motivational line. It is the actual constraint. Recruiting is on the critical path here, and you will be able to see your work in the flight schedule.
The job
You own top of funnel for our software engineering roles: backend, frontend, autonomy, forward deployed. You will be reading GitHub profiles, writing outreach that engineers answer, and building searches that keep producing after the obvious names are gone.
Then the interesting part. Inside your first year you move onto the aircraft side: propulsion, structures, avionics, manufacturing, production. Almost nobody sources both. The people who can are rare enough that it changes what your career looks like from that point forward. We will teach you, and you will be bad at it for a while, and then you will not be.
What you get here that you did not get there
Your own reqs, early, with your name on the outcome
Hiring managers in the same building, not behind an intake form
The freedom to change the message when it is not working, without asking three people first
Someone who runs sourcing searches themselves every day and will look at your search strings with you
A skill set at the end of two years that maybe a few hundred people in the country have
What we need from you
1+ years of sourcing or recruiting, most of it in software engineering
A hire you are proud of, one nobody else was going to find, and the ability to walk us through exactly how you found them
A high tolerance for silence, because most of your outreach will go unanswered and the job is making the next message better anyway
Real curiosity about how aircraft get built, or at least the honesty to say you find it interesting and want in
Writing that sounds like a person, since your entire work product is text a stranger decides to open or delete
Clean data habits, because our reporting goes to the CEO and it needs to be right
What we do not need
Ten years of experience. A recruiting pedigree. A degree in anything specific. Permission from your current manager to be good at this.
The honest version
The pace is uncomfortable. You will be asked to fill roles you do not understand yet, and the answer will usually be to go learn them rather than to wait for a briefing.
If you want a clear ladder and a quiet quarter, this is the wrong job. If you have been waiting for someone to hand you something real, this is the shot.

Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.
Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.
Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.
Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.
Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

As a Senior Recruiter, you'll join Proxima Fusion's Talent Acquisition team, reporting into our Recruiter lead, at a moment when we're scaling on two fronts at once: growing our deep-tech engineering and science teams, and building out the manufacturing workforce behind Alpha and Stellaris.
You'll take full ownership of complex, often niche searches, act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, and help shape how the TA team hires for manufacturing and industrial roles alongside our technical hiring. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants more scope and more say in how we build the function, without stepping away from the recruiting itself.

Lead recruitment for manufacturing and production roles as we ramp up facilities — technicians, operators, quality and manufacturing engineers — building sourcing channels beyond the usual technical hiring playbook.

Champion an outstanding candidate experience at every touchpoint, adapting your approach for very different audiences — from a senior scientist to a shop-floor hire.
Contribute to TA projects beyond your own reqs: improving workflows and tooling, building out our German-market employer brand, or delivering interview training.
Help the Head of Talent Acquisition build a high-trust, high-rigor process that supports scaling without compromising on quality.
